summary: Keen Vision Acquisition Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing the issuance of a $120,000 unsecured promissory note to sponsor KVC Sponsor LLC on April 21, 2026. Proceeds were deposited into the trust account to extend the business-combination deadline to July 27, 2026. The note is non-interest-bearing, matures upon a business combination, and may be converted into units at $10.00/unit. This is a routine SPAC extension filing; no transaction has been announced. Watch for a future de-SPAC announcement or liquidation if no deal closes by the extended date.
